os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"

    if "CONTRA" in lu: return "False"

def parse_problem(problem_text):
    marker = "\n\nDetermine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:\n"
    if marker in problem_text:
        parts = problem_text.split(marker, 1)
        return parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
    return problem_text, ""

def sc_alpha(vote_dist):
    filtered = {k: v for k, v in vote_dist.items() if k in CLASSES}
    if not filtered: return "Unknown"
    max_count = max(filtered.values())
    tied = sorted([k for k, v in filtered.items() if v == max_count])
    return tied[0]

def combo_alpha(vote_dist, nli_pred, w):
    combined = {}
    for k, v in vote_dist.items():
        if k in CLASSES:
            combined[k] = combined.get(k, 0) + v
    if nli_pred in CLASSES:
        combined[nli_pred] = combined.get(nli_pred, 0) + w
    if not combined: return "Unknown"
    max_count = max(combined.values())
    tied = sorted([k for k, v in combined.items() if v == max_count])
    return tied[0]

def run_inference(model_name, model_path, pw_data, device):
    print(f"Loading {model_name}: {model_path}", flush=True)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_path, local_files_only=True)
    model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(model_path, local_files_only=True)
    model.to(device).eval()
    id2label = model.config.id2label
    nli_to_pw = {idx: map_nli_label(lbl) for idx, lbl in id2label.items()}
    print(f"  id2label: {id2label}, mapped: {nli_to_pw}", flush=True)

    preds = {}

    for i, q in enumerate(pw_data):

        if not conclusion:

        with torch.no_grad():

    print(f"  Done in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s", flush=True)
    del model

def mcnemar_p(correct_a, correct_b):
    b = sum(1 for i in range(len(correct_a)) if correct_a[i] and not correct_b[i])
    c = sum(1 for i in range(len(correct_a)) if not correct_a[i] and correct_b[i])

def exact_spearman_p(x, y, alternative='two-sided'):
    n = len(x)
    rho_obs, _ = spearmanr(x, y)
    count_extreme = 0
    total = 0
    for perm in permutations(range(n)):
        y_perm = [y[i] for i in perm]
